subject: Marketplace VAT revocation: request for invoice reissue and tax docs
messages:
From: CloudResell Ltd <finance@cloudresell.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VAT registration revoked -- need invoices reissued

Hi Sofia,

We just received notification from AWS Marketplace that our EU VAT registration for the reseller entity (CloudResell Ltd, GB-123456789) has been revoked effective 2026-05-30. As a result AWS is instructing that marketplace transactions for May 2026 be reissued as gross (no reverse charge) and the marketplace ledger has flagged several invoices.

Can Redwood reissue the invoice lines that were billed via the marketplace for the listed subscriptions? We also need copies of any vendor tax documentation you have on file (W-9 / W-8 if applicable) and a short letter confirming:

- Which legal entity Redwood used to list the product in AWS Marketplace (vendor-of-record vs reseller model)
- The tax registration number (VAT / TIN) associated with the billed entity
- Confirmation that Redwood will cooperate with the marketplace to reissue invoices or provide credit notes

For reference I have attached the original_invoice_20260501.pdf that AWS flagged. Please advise next steps and timeline — AWS is asking for evidence within 7 business days so we need to move quickly.

Thanks,
Aisha Green
Finance Manager
CloudResell Ltd
(attachment: original_invoice_20260501.pdf)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: CloudResell Ltd <finance@cloudresell.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VAT registration revoked -- need invoices reissued

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the heads up — sorry to hear about the revocation. We can support reissuing invoices but need to confirm a few items before we engage AWS Marketplace ops: 

1) Which entity did we register as the vendor on that listing? (vendor-of-record or listed via reseller pass-through)
2) Do you want the reissued invoice routed to CloudResell as the purchaser (gross) or do you prefer a credit + redebit approach?
3) Please attach your most recent VAT certificate (or notice of revocation) and the buyer PO/reference for the subscriptions in question.

Tentative plan from our side:
- I will loop in Marketplace Billing ops to check whether AWS will accept an API-driven invoice reissue or whether a credit memo + new invoice is required.
- Finance will need a completed W-9 (if the billing entity is US) or W-8BEN-E for non-US entities; if CloudResell is multi-entity we may need per-entity docs.

If you can get the VAT revocation notice and the PO/reference to me by end of day tomorrow we’ll start the internal workflow. I’ve cc'd Vanessa and Karthik to help coordinate the playbook and finance steps.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Marketplace VAT reissue playbook & next steps

Sofia / Karthik — quick internal note and action items based on Aisha's ask: 

- Confirmed: the listing for this product is Vendor-of-Record (Redwood EU Ltd) per our marketplace catalog. That means Redwood invoices the marketplace, but AWS issues the customer-facing invoice depending on marketplace policy.
- Action 1 (Ops): Open a ticket with AWS Marketplace Billing Ops to request reissuance of impacted invoices and ask whether they will accept an "invoice reissue" vs credit + re-invoice. If reissue is supported, provide a CSV of invoice IDs and target invoicing mode.
- Action 2 (Finance): Prepare W-9/W-8 checklist for CloudResell and verify which legal entity on their side matches the invoices. We will need: entity name, VAT/TIN, jurisdiction, and PO numbers.
- Action 3 (Legal): Draft a short confirmation letter stating Redwood's listing entity and VAT/TIN for the vendor-of-record. Legal ok to sign once we have the full list.

Notes and playbook links: shared the internal runbook here: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-marketplace-playbook (see folder "reissue-workflow"). Karthik, can your team prepare the CSV of invoice IDs if Aisha provides the list?

I'll take the lead on the AWS ticket and keep Aisha updated. We should propose a 5-business-day SLA for completion assuming we get vendor docs promptly.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Director, Cloud Channels
Redwood Inference

Quick technical note — ops/finance coordination items I've started: 

- If CloudResell provides a CSV with invoice IDs and target entity mapping we can: 
  * Call the Marketplace API to request a reissue (where supported) and attach a vendor confirmation letter
  * For marketplaces that require credit + reissue, we will create credit memos in our ledger and issue new invoices via the marketplace connector so the gross amounts reflect VAT.
- Please ask CloudResell to confirm whether the affected subscriptions were billed to their UK entity or a local EU branch (we need the exact company registration number). Different countries have different reversal rules and evidence requirements.
- Attached example: provisional_reissue_20260501_invoice.pdf (stub) — this is how the reissued doc will be formatted if AWS accepts reissue.

I'll also add a short checklist for Finance: W-9 if US entity; W-8BEN-E + declaration if non-US; VAT revocation notice. Once we have the docs we'll queue the ledger updates.

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VAT registration revoked -- plan to reissue invoices and required docs

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for sending the revocation notice and the list of impacted invoice IDs. Per our internal review and a preliminary exchange with AWS Marketplace Ops, Redwood will proceed with the following: 

1) AWS has confirmed they support a marketplace-side invoice reissue for the flagged records. We will submit the request and attach a vendor confirmation letter from Redwood EU Ltd (VAT: EU-987654321).
2) Finance requires one of the following per affected CloudResell entity: W-9 (US entities) OR W-8BEN-E + latest local VAT/registration evidence for EU entities. We also need the purchaser PO numbers you referenced.
3) If AWS declines reissue for any invoice, Redwood will issue a credit memo and request AWS to publish a new invoice reflecting gross amounts.

Timeline: we will open the AWS ticket today and expect an initial response within 48 hours. Reissue/credit completion target: 5 business days after AWS accepts the ticket and we receive all tax documents.

Attached: provisional_reissue_20260501_invoice.pdf (format stub). Once you confirm which legal entity the invoices should be mapped to and provide the W-9/W-8, we'll kick the reissue workflow.

Please reply to confirm and upload the docs to a secure share or send them to finance@cloudresell.com with the Redwood ticket ref.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachment: provisional_reissue_20260501_invoice.pdf)
